title: EIP-8205: Withdrawal credentials preregistration
description: Bind a validator public key to withdrawal credentials before deposit via an EL system contract enforced by the CL
author: George Avsetsin (@avsetsin), Dmitry Gusakov (@dgusakov), Greg Koumoutsos (@gkoumout), Eugene Mamin (@TheDZhon)
laymanDescription: When one party funds a validator and another generates its key, the key holder can deposit first and permanently point the withdrawals at itself. Every staking provider has built its own defense against this. This proposal lets a key holder commit to withdrawal credentials before any deposit, and has the protocol enforce that commitment.
benefits: Replaces each protocol's home-built front-running defense with one protocol-level guarantee
Fully optional, so deposits for keys without a preregistration behave exactly as today
Lets guardian-committee protocols drop depositRoot rotation and committee liveness risk
tradeoffs: A mismatched deposit is rejected and its ETH is stuck in the deposit contract forever
The signed commitment can be replayed after expiry, so signing is effectively irrevocable
Adds a system contract, a request type, and up to roughly 46 MB of beacon state
